verdict.rationale: Cline's CLI supports referencing images inline (e.g., "@./screenshot.png") to guide fixes, implying some image-to-code capability, but there is no documented support for generating a full app from a sketch or PDF design, nor any PDF ingestion capability. missing for 10: explicit PDF/design-file ingestion, end-to-end 'sketch-to-app' workflow documentation, and any example or case study of generating a complete app from an image/PDF mockup.
